rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: At its meeting of Thursday 20 March 2025 the Diretório Nacional made official ('oficializou') Senator Humberto Costa as the party's President, replacing Gleisi Hoffmann, by 63 votes in favour, none against and 5 abstentions; his mandate runs until the party's next internal elections in the PED 2025 in July.
